newsitem.title: USA: Data Processing Resources sells shares.
newsitem.headline: Data Processing Resources sells shares.

text.p: Data Processing Resources Corp on Wednesday said it has begun a public offering of 2.1 million common shares at $17.50 a share.
One company shareholder also is offering 200,000 shares at the same price.

The company and shareholder granted underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option for 295,000 and 50,000 common shares, respectively. Underwriters were led by Montgomery Securities, Robert W. Baird & Co Inc and Lehman Brothers.
Net proceeds will be used to continue expanding via acquisitions and new branch openings, the company said.
